resources.string:
SolStream Studio optionally uses the Android AccessibilityService API to:

1. Display an assistive floating in-game broadcast control dock (TYPE_ACCESSIBILITY_OVERLAY) for one-tap microphone mute, privacy blur shield, scene switching, and clip markers over full-screen games.
2. Maintain continuous microphone audio routing alongside internal game audio when full-screen multiplayer games activate in-game squad voice chat.

Privacy & Security Guarantee:
• SolStream Studio CANNOT read screen text, passwords, messages, or personal data (canRetrieveWindowContent is strictly false and canPerformGestures is false).
• Zero audio, video, or personal data is ever collected, stored, or transmitted to developer servers; all broadcast streams are sent directly to your own configured RTMP/RTMPS server.
• This service is only active while you use SolStream Studio, and you may decline or disable it at any time and continue streaming with standard microphone capture.
